evals.prompt: I just finished all the tasks in Phase 2 of my React Native project. Can you do a harness-review before I start Phase 3?
evals.expected_output: Claude runs git diff to get the Phase 2 changes, determines project type (React Native → includes Accessibility dimension), reviews all 4 perspectives, outputs a structured table, and either APPROVEs (offering to commit) or REQUEST_CHANGEs with specific actionable findings.

assertions.text: Output includes a structured table with Severity, File, Finding, Fix columns
Response includes either APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES outcome label
Project type is correctly identified (React Native → Accessibility included; Node/Python API → Accessibility skipped)
The planted security/quality issue is caught (JWT secret logged, SQL injection via f-string, or error swallowed in catch)
Findings include specific file references or line numbers, not vague suggestions
